name: sgr-defect-act-registry
description: Реестр дефектных актов СГР — внутренний продукт Dana Holding

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/config build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/jobs build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/worker build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/config build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/jobs build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain test && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database test && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api test && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/web test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/jobs build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database test:integration && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/api test:integration
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/domain build && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database generate && pnpm --filter @sgr-registry/database seed
scripts.infra:up: node scripts/dev/sync-redis-secrets.mjs && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --env-file .env up -d
